method: scripts/f1_tune.py: walk-forward grid over 2012-2026 (2014-2026 scored; each season picks the configuration best on the seasons before it). The post-qualifying pick was the same configuration in every season (p0.9_k40). The pre-qualifying grid source is the qualifying model, which was best overall at 2,000 simulations and the walk-forward pick from 2021 on.

edge_research_2026_10_02.QUALI_PACE_W/QUALI_PACE_SD_MULT: grid w in {0.25..0.75} x sd in {0.35..1.0}, 3000 sims, 267 races 2014-2026; chosen on 2014-2022 (winner log-loss after qualifying 1.383 -> 1.323), walk-forward picks converge on (0.4, 0.5) from 2021; 2023-2026 1.199 -> 1.108
edge_research_2026_10_02.qualifying.PRACTICE_SHORT_W: practice one-lap pace in the qualifying model (sessions starting before GP qualifying); grid {0.25,0.5,0.75,1.0} on 2023-2026. Strict walk-forward on pole log-loss (train 2023, expanding) picks 0.25 each season: 2024-2026 pole 1.824 -> 1.628. 0.5 is best over all 2023-2026 pole data (1.611 vs 1.616 at 0.25) and better for the race winner (2024-2026 1.711 -> 1.640), so 0.5
